column1: # WHISP edge-on galaxies: warp onset radii and the scales they might track.
# Transcribed by hand (2026-09-03) from the published tables of two papers.  Every number below appears in print;
# nothing here is fitted, interpolated or invented.  Where a paper prints a dash or a question mark the cell is "nan".
# SOURCE A -- Garcia-Ruiz, Sancisi & Kuijken 2002, A&A 394, 769 (arXiv astro-ph/0207112)
#   Table 1: R25 (arcmin), Ropt (arcmin, the visually-judged edge of the disc), inclination (deg),
#            dV (Mpc, Virgocentric-inflow distance), dTF (Mpc, Tully-Fisher distance).
#   Table 4: RHI (arcmin, radius at 1 Msun/pc^2 face-on), MHI (1e8 Msun), W20, W50 (km/s, global profile widths),
#            warp angles on the two sides (deg; "nan" where the paper prints ---), env (0 poor / 1 intermediate / 2 rich).
# SOURCE B -- van der Kruit 2007, A&A 466, 883 (arXiv astro-ph/0702486), Table 3:
#   Rdeep (arcmin, stellar-disc truncation radius on the deep clip; the paper takes Rmax = Rdeep),
#   Rwarp (arcmin, radius at which the HI warp sets in, AS PROJECTED ON THE SKY -- a LOWER limit on the
#          in-plane onset radius; the paper's own statistical deprojection gives an intrinsic Rwarp ~ 1.1 Rmax),
#   Rwarp_over_Rmax as the paper prints it.
#   Sides: where van der Kruit lists two sides (UGC 7125, 8246, 8709) the warped side is taken.
#   UGC 1281's Rwarp carries a "?" in the paper and is flagged here.
# ADDED ON THE AUDIT PASS, from the same van der Kruit 2007 Table 3 and its section 5 text:
#   trunc          -- the paper's own "trunc.?" column: is there evidence for a stellar-disc truncation?
#                     Where it is "no", R_deep is only the apparent disc size at the deep clip level and is
#                     NOT a truncation radius R_max, so the disc-edge comparison is not like-for-like there.
#   vdk_disturbed  -- 1 for UGC 5986, 7125 and 8246, which van der Kruit explicitly removes from his own
#                     statistical discussion as disturbed systems ("not normal"; two-sided or with a companion).
#   His clean statistic is the 12 galaxies with trunc = yes AND a printed R_warp AND vdk_disturbed = 0.
UGC
